prompt:
Create a HIGH RESOLUTION 3072 pixel square production sprite sheet for a 2D cozy cartoon tea shop game. One sheet with an EXACT uniform 3 columns x 3 rows GRID of equal-sized INVISIBLE rectangular cells, row-major ordering left to right then top to bottom. One completely separate object per cell. All objects separated by very generous fully transparent gutters (at least 10% cell size), absolutely no touching/overlap, NO drawn grid lines, NO labels or numbers. Blank cells fully empty. Objects are centered WITHIN their own cells with complete unobstructed silhouettes, furniture EMPTY and all tabletop objects separate. Exact layout:
Row 1, column 1: One EMPTY very long narrow wooden preparation bench aligned vertically along the LEFT wall in the reference. Its long axis runs top to bottom of image, visible wooden rectangular top occupies most length, thin front/side apron and short legs at bottom. Pure orthographic elevated view, no jars, tools, trays or ingredients on it. Overall silhouette width:height .35:1.
Row 1, column 2: One EMPTY wide wooden support table for two tea machines. Cream warm beige clean rectangular tabletop, warm brown apron and short sturdy legs; no equipment, no pipes, no objects. Width:height about 3.45:1.
Row 1, column 3: One complete cream colored electric brewing pot from reference center top, wide round open metal rim with warm amber tea and a few stylized dark tea pieces, dark side handles and small dark heating base/side control block. This is the game's tea brewer. Show complete pot and handles, no animal, no table, no other machines, no connecting pipe to other machine. Width:height about1.32:1.
Row 2, column 1: One cream colored automatic milk mixing machine shaped like reference top-center-right brewer. Rounded tall rectangular appliance body, inset small charcoal control screen with three amber bars, one round button, a small dispensing nozzle, charcoal drip tray at bottom. No cup on tray, no table, no connecting pipe to other objects. Width:height about .85:1.
Row 2, column 2: One EMPTY horizontal charcoal-gray conveyor belt module, rectangular belt with subtly visible horizontal slat seams, thick rounded dark brown rim, gray circular motor ends, short support legs. No arrows, drinks, cups, machines, or other items. Wide orthographic front elevated view width:height2.03:1.
Row 2, column 3: One EMPTY long vertical charcoal-gray conveyor belt module, long axis top-to-bottom, subtly visible transverse slat seams, dark brown rim, small support base. No arrows, drinks, cups, machine or other objects. Orthographic elevated view, width:height .55:1.
Row 3, column 1: One compact EMPTY right-angle conveyor corner connector for horizontal-to-vertical dark charcoal conveyor, soft rounded belt and same dark brown rims, no machine, cups, arrows or other objects. Orthographic view same elevated camera.
Row 3, column 2: One cream colored cup sealing machine matching reference right side. Tall rounded enclosure, front open dark cup loading cavity, small red/green status lights on right edge, visible pink sealing head near cavity top, short base. No cup inside, no conveyor, no table. Orthographic parallel edges, width:height .84:1.
Row 3, column 3: One EMPTY two-tier open wooden drink rack matching supplied reference, warm medium-brown shelves, TWO horizontal levels with three-cup-wide usable area each, two slender vertical side posts projecting a little above top shelf, no backing panel, no drinks, no bubbles or objects. Orthographic frontal elevated view, identical shelf widths, parallel posts. Width:height1.03:1.
Style: follow provided tea shop reference faithfully but more refined, precise and clean. Soft warm hand-painted cartoon game illustration with rounded shapes, confident dark brown contour, warm honey medium wood, cream appliances, gentle upper-left highlights; consistent line thickness, lighting and same elevated frontal camera across EVERY object. Strict orthographic projection: parallel edges stay parallel, NO vanishing point, no perspective convergence, no isometric diamond orientation. Wooden tables have EMPTY plain tops, no baked on props; no characters, lettering, bubbles, other scene furniture, floor, tile patterns, checkerboard, vignette, glow or backgrounds. Real transparent RGBA background everywhere outside silhouettes and all gutters. Keep shading simple and edges crisp, not photorealistic. Use entire high resolution canvas efficiently while preserving transparent gutters. Only listed objects, complete independent sprites.
